root_causes_and_corrections: http.response_usage formerly retained nonstream cache counters only for OpenRouter; direct Anthropic accounting passed only noncache input to cost.estimate; cost.estimate discarded every cache/TTL category.

Normalization now exposes supplied read/write counters through all Providers and paths. Anthropic total prompt adds disjoint noncache/read/write categories; OpenAI/OpenRouter/Gemini counters remain subsets. Available Anthropic TTL details survive native streaming snapshots.

Locked LiteLLM get_model_info silently substitutes zero for missing base price fields. The estimator validates applicable prices against the original local model_cost entry selected by info.key, then calls the real cost_per_token using a Usage object with inclusive prompt totals and prompt_tokens_details. No price multipliers are hardcoded.

Session Report formerly aggregated purposes only. It now attributes Attempts by explicit opening, Turn End, next opening and Run boundaries; malformed boundaries stop attribution until a new known opening. It retains the latest 20 executions and at most 16 consecutive purpose/route groups each.

The final self-check reproduced invalid streamed cost entering retained raw usage without an earlier valid cost in five failing cases. Invalid money is now ignored while prior valid reported cost and independent counters survive, preserving the existing stream failure contract.

omission_policy: OpenAI: require both cache-read and cache-write counts for an estimate. Current docs have different cache write/minimum behavior by model generation, so no universal omitted-zero assumption is used. Missing fields remain unknown in report coverage.

Anthropic: this application sends no cache_control and does not activate native caching; official caching activation/default-TTL contracts support existing uncached omitted-zero calculation. Supplied cache counts/TTL evidence are validated. Coverage still retains absence.

Gemini: official GenerateContent proto defines cached_content_token_count as implicit-presence int32. ProtoJSON may omit its zero, so calculation may use zero for an omitted scalar while coverage stays absent. This path creates no explicit cache resource or write/storage charge.

glossary_proposal.Estimated Cost: A Call Log Attempt's cost when it did not come from the Provider itself. OpenRouter's reported cost remains authoritative. Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini estimates use locked local LiteLLM pricing with normalized inclusive prompt totals, supplied cache-read/write counts and reported Anthropic write TTLs, marked cost_estimated: true. Invalid, unsupported or incomplete required pricing evidence leaves cost unavailable. Provider-contract omitted-zero rules apply only to calculation; absent counters remain unknown report coverage. Run spend charges each available physical Attempt cost once; historical recorded costs are not rewritten.
glossary_proposal.Session Report: The bounded local /report view of recorded current-Session activity across Runs, retaining Session/purpose aggregates and independent metric coverage before optional detail. It shows the latest 20 explicit submission/Retry executions with Run/opening identity, original ordinal, recorded outcome or unresolved state, and up to 16 consecutive purpose/route groups per execution. Ordinary routes retain Attempt/retry, duration, first-text, token/cache and cost provenance evidence; maintenance is separate. Cache-read fractions use compatible same samples. Omission/partial-inspection notices, redaction and terminal sanitization remain explicit. Route changes and adjacent cache observations establish no causality or savings. Reporting adds only its existing Audit Event and changes no routing, Conversation, pending work, configuration, latest /usage or spend.
